verdict.rationale: The evidence shows agent-friendly building blocks: an official MCP server for natural-language access to Adyen's platform, webhooks that push final payment outcomes, and OpenAPI definition files. It also mentions payout configuration per merchant account. None of it documents an API for listing transactions, retrieving payouts or settlement reports, or reconciling daily takings into a ledger. Missing for 10: documented transaction/settlement report retrieval API, payout data retrieval via API, MCP tools covering transactions or payouts, reconciliation or ledger-export guidance, independent hands-on corroboration.
